question: TILE is related to VLNH in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, RAMP is related to TDOS. To which of the following is SORT related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/914456ecd02a295fcb6a97049dfda1145c674dab9f03e8a7de5db8403c4b7657.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**TILE: VLNH**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5ddb281cb16a0c131b7fab26f2bd0608d13e15557c3e57de57e8899d05fe3a5.png] 

**RAMP: TDOS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c594ccd323624135b77ea6bbee8700833cd926cd1a7a2db9c5c73733a6e8e3d4.png] 

Similarly,

**SORT: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b79d013b1615c1522454552446b862d2732d78b66fc443b5e5bdd74fb0d4f6c7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"URTW"**.
